title: Keeping Database Size Under the Limit

facts.text: Reducing database size prevents reaching size limits in Business Central online, improves runtime performance, and simplifies backup and restore processes.
Delete unused companies such as test or demo companies to reduce stored data.
Delete historical documents no longer needed like invoiced purchase orders.
Set up retention policies to automatically delete outdated data in log and archived record tables.
Business Central online automatically enables page-level data compression on tables unless CompressionType property is set to None.
Enable data compression on tables using CompressionType property or Start-NAVDatabaseCompression cmdlet for on-premises 2020 release wave 1 and later.
